name: @local/session-purge
description: Permanently erase one DSH conversation and its local traces: releases a running agent, removes logs (zero-overwritten), subagent descendants, projection cache, workspace accounting, unshared attachments and file-cache records.

meta.title: 彻底删除对话
meta.description: 从会话头部或侧栏菜单彻底抹除一个会话：先释放运行中的 Agent，再写零并删除日志，级联删除子代理会话，清理投影缓存、工作区记账与未共享附件。
